secondaryMetrics: all existing internal phase wall timers
conditioning: One fresh child alive at a time. Each child completes two excluded full-corpus warmups, one timed full-corpus pass and one subsequent exhaustive verification, then exits before the next arm starts. Node defaults; no GC/tiering flags, retries, replacements, extra samples or result-based stopping.
boundary: Actual production parser-worker component on preloaded compressed banks, including inflate/CRC, grammar/content/dedup, lookup preparation, ownership copies and media-path projection. Excludes source archive loading, process/module startup, real IPC/parallel scheduling, DB/OPFS, compression, media-payload import, browser UI and lookup readiness.
reverseDefinition: One fixed candidate. Reverse its complete18-child schedule: reverse the six block orders and reverse each block arm order.
interpretation: Prospective separate VNDB component motivated by fixed operation counts and complete correctness gates, registered before observing any pending JMdict hosted result. Source and all conditioning are unchanged. Untimed corpus verification durations are not interpreted. Hosts are separate, and all B/A, B/C and identical C/A observations and failures remain. No complete-import or memory benefit follows from this diagnostic; no retries, replacements, added samples or result-based changes.
groupBankListsHashEncoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(grouping.groups), with no whitespace or newline; all bank names are ASCII.
fixedWorkGuardScope: Audit-only admissions from the retained untimed VNDB baseline proof. The byte-identical generic controller still checks complete equality across every pass; the separate offline artifact audit also checks these registered values.
